architecture.mechanism: PID-affected solar modules exhibit regular degradation patterns as the neutral point of voltage in a module string moves forward to the positive pole over time
architecture.intervention: Implement a voltage balancing system that prevents the neutral point from shifting toward the positive pole by actively monitoring and redistributing voltage across the module string
architecture.expected_effect: Stabilize the voltage distribution within the module string to prevent sodium ion migration and maintain power output below 0.5% annual degradation over 25 years
architecture.falsification_test: Compare power degradation rates between module strings with and without the voltage balancing system over a 5-year period under identical operating conditions at 1000 V system bias
